notes: Two-column parliamentary minutes where most crops span both columns: 13 of the 20 random lines are wrong, either joining two half-lines across the gutter (1, 3, 4, 6, 19, 20) or showing a two-column box while the label holds only one half or a different line (7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14, 17). Among the anomalous lines, 23, 38, 39, 40 have labels that do not match the crop at all. The only usable lines are short single-column ones (2, 5, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18), so a gutter rule would leave little, and that little is unreliable.
